points_of_interest.name: Pilgrims church "Maria in the wine field" Volkach
points_of_interest.description: A beautiful little church. Here you can witness the artwork "Madonna im Rozenkranz" by Tillman von Riemenschneider.

points_of_interest.description:
Entrance free, well on the left in entrance tower. nice bookshop.
also backery and Butcher. Toilets right off the church
